summary.ja: 硬い常微分方程式の減衰を扱う2段2次の陰的Runge–Kutta法。公開版はγ=1−1/√2のstiffly accurateなL安定SDIRKで、各段階にNewton法を用い、別のラッパーでステップ倍化による局所誤差制御を行う。 追加固定例：Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差、van der Polの短時間剛性遷移。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 固定した教育用実行例：酵素反応の保存と準定常近似。
summary.en: A two-stage second-order implicit Runge–Kutta method for stiff ODE decay. The release uses stiffly accurate L-stable SDIRK with γ=1−1/√2 and Newton stage solves; a separate wrapper adds step-doubling local-error control. Additional fixed examples: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error, Van der Pol: an early stiffness transition. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Fixed educational executions: Enzyme conservation and QSSA.

assumptions: The target is an ODE y'=f(t,y) represented by a real one-dimensional array, with a consistent Jacobian ∂f/∂y supplied by the caller.
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]], b=(1−γ,γ), c=(γ,1), and γ=1−1/√2. This stiffly accurate form returns the last stage.
With exact stage solves, R(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2. This γ gives A-stability and R→0 as |z|→∞ in the left half-plane.

Newton convergence is required at each stage. Distinguish fixed-step integrate from adaptive_sdirk2, which estimates error from (two half steps−one full step)/3 and accepts the two-half-step solution.
units: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
boundary_conditions: Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.

limitations.ja: L安定性は正確な段階解を前提とする線形試験方程式の性質であり、大刻みの精度・非線形収束・正値性を保証しない。Newton失敗時は固定版が例外、適応版が試行棄却を行う。埋込み対ではなくステップ倍化で、rtol/atolは局所誤差尺度であり最終大域誤差の保証ではない。一般DAE、質量行列、イベント処理は未実装。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
limitations.en: L-stability concerns the linear test equation with accurate stage solves; it guarantees neither large-step accuracy, nonlinear convergence nor positivity. A Newton failure raises in the fixed version and rejects a trial in the adaptive wrapper. Adaptivity uses step doubling, not an embedded pair; rtol/atol control a local error scale, not a guaranteed final global error. General DAEs, mass matrices and events are not implemented. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound. This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

assumptions_ja: 対象は実数の1次元配列で表すODE y'=f(t,y)。整合するJacobian ∂f/∂yを呼び出し側が与える。
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]]、b=(1−γ,γ)、c=(γ,1)、γ=1−1/√2。最終段を次の解にするstiffly accurate版。
正確な段階解に対する安定関数はR(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2。このγではA安定かつ左半平面で|z|→∞のときR→0となる。
実装では各段階のNewton収束が必要。固定刻みintegrateと、(2半歩−1全歩)/3を使って2半歩の解を採用するadaptive_sdirk2を区別する。
units_ja: hは時間、f_iはy_i/時間、Jacobian要素J_ijはy_i/(y_j×時間)。無次元化または成分尺度の調整が必要で、固定のNewton許容値2×10^-12は任意の物理単位に自動対応しない。適応版のatolは状態尺度、rtolは無次元。
boundary_conditions_ja: ODE時間積分単体には空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEの半離散系に使う場合、境界条件とその時刻依存性を右辺とJacobianへ整合して組み込む。

assumptions.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。
assumptions.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs.

algorithm.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。
algorithm.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result.

validation.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。
validation.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately.

limits.ja: 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
limits.en: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

summary.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism.

assumptions.ja: 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
assumptions.en: Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

algorithm.ja: 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
algorithm.en: Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.

validation.ja: 独立な全系Radau/BDF参照、縮約式の陰的スカラー恒等式、E+C=E₀とS+C+P=1、正値性、実際の採用・棄却・Newton作業を照合。初期層を含む全時間と、事前指定θ≥0.02の近似誤差を別保存します。
validation.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window.

scope.ja: 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。
scope.en: Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references.

method_note.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。 解析Jacobian付き固定BE/Newtonを使い、質量の投影・濃度クリップはしません。
method_note.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result. Use fixed BE/Newton with analytic Jacobians and no mass projection or concentration clipping.

name.ja: van der Polの短時間剛性遷移
name.en: Van der Pol: an early stiffness transition

caption.ja: 保存済みの固定刻み比較と局所/大域誤差の区別。初回208/209で、μ=1適応法の大域目標2e-5は未達のまま保持します。 図の軌道・状態・時刻・反復の軸は、物理空間の次元を表しません。
caption.en: Saved fixed-step comparisons and the local/global error distinction. The first study met 208/209 targets; the unmet mu = 1 adaptive global goal of 2e-5 remains recorded. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions.

name.ja: van der Polの短時間剛性遷移
name.en: Van der Pol: an early stiffness transition

scope.ja: 局所制御と大域誤差を分離します。初回は元209目標中208達成で、μ=1の厳しい適応設定は大域目標2e-5に未達でした。
scope.en: Separate local control from global error. The first study met 208 of 209 original targets; the mu = 1 tight adaptive run missed the 2e-5 global goal.

method_note.ja: BDF2/SDIRK2と倍分割適応法。解析Jacobian・段階内だけの因子再利用・失敗時の候補保存を実装します。
method_note.en: Use actual BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling, analytic Jacobians, factor reuse within each implicit stage, and retained candidates on failure.

name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似

caption.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。 保存値だけを描画します。 時間・濃度・個体数の軸は空間次元ではありません。率は教育用で疾病・実験予測ではありません。
caption.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism. This figure reads saved data only. Time, concentrations and populations do not define a spatial dimension. The rates are educational, not disease or experimental predictions.

name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似

scope.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。
scope.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism.

method_note.ja: 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
method_note.en: Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.

note.ja: 既存の固定入力・保存結果に対応する解析参照カードを追加。解析式、点・時刻・動径の標本化、配布版SHAと実行コードを相互に辿れます。過去の計算を再実行した記録ではありません。
note.en: An analytic reference card now links the existing fixed inputs and saved results: formula, point/time/radial sampling, edition SHA and executable code. This metadata registration is not a new execution.

note.ja: 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.
